subject: POC handoff & capacity rehearsal — onsite vs remote logistics
messages:
From: Daniel King <daniel.king@clarityhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: olivia.park@clarityhealth.com, ops@clarityhealth.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify kickoff format & rehearsal — recording and visitor access

Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team liked the latency numbers. We're trying to lock the POC kickoff for the week of Sep 20. Two quick asks so we can decide whether to come onsite or run remotely:

- Can Redwood host recording of the hands-on session? Our legal needs a short note on where recordings are stored and who can access them.
- For onsite: what is the visitor check-in process and what documents do we need to provide for facility access?
- For remote: do you support presenting with multiple attendee screens (we have 3 engineers who will hand off prompts)? Any restrictions on screen sharing/streaming?

Also, can we run a short routing/load rehearsal with ~20 concurrent users for 30 minutes prior to the kickoff? We want to validate throughput and any fallback routing.

Appreciate a quick runbook or checklist we can share with our Security and Facility teams.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel King
Director, Platform Engineering
Clarity Health
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Daniel King <daniel.king@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, olivia.park@clarityhealth.com, ops@clarityhealth.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify kickoff format & rehearsal — recording and visitor access

Hi Daniel —

Thanks — happy to confirm details. Short answers up front, followed by a proposed checklist.

Recording: yes, we can record the session. Recordings are stored in our secure S3 bucket (access controlled via IAM) for 90 days by default; longer retention can be arranged under an enterprise addendum. Access is restricted to the named Redwood hosts and the customer IAM principals you share with us.

Visitor access (onsite): Redwood staff will meet guests at main lobby. We require a completed site access form (we can accept scanned PDFs) and government ID at check-in. We can provide a temporary badge for up to 2 days.

Screen sharing (remote): we support multi-presenter screens via our streaming link (WebRTC-based) and Zoom is available as a fallback. For hands-on prompts, we recommend each external engineer join the runner VM we provide instead of relying on remote desktop — that way routing/load behavior matches production.

Routing/load rehearsal: we can run a 30-minute 20-concurrent-user load test. We'll need a 1-hour window to provision and warm up caches. If you want to test fallback routing, we recommend one simulated region outage for 5 minutes.

Proposed checklist (attached):
- Confirm final attendee list and onsite vs remote by Sep 13
- Complete & return site_access_form.pdf for onsite attendees
- Choose recording retention: 90 days (default) or 365 days (enterprise)
- Schedule a 1-hour preflight window for routing/load rehearsal (we suggest Sep 19 morning)
- Provide prompt seed set for quality checks by Sep 15

I've attached an agenda and the site access form. Ben and Marcus will add notes on room booking and the runner VMs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: poc-agenda-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), clarity_site_access_form.pdf (pdf)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Daniel King <daniel.king@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, olivia.park@clarityhealth.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify kickoff format & rehearsal — recording and visitor access

Looping in logistics notes. Two items from my side:

1) Room booking (if onsite): We have two rooms that fit a hands-on sprint — Lab-3 (up to 12 guests, built-in AV, 1G uplink) and Orchard Room (up to 25, bring-your-own-laptops). Lab-3 has restricted badge access so we need final names 48 hours ahead. Orchard Room needs an AV tech if you want recording.

2) Runner VMs & load: we'll provide per-guest runner VMs (Ubuntu + Redwood CLI) that attach to a pre-warmed model instance. For the rehearsal, please provide a list of 20 unique user agents or we can synthesize. Note that continuous-batching behavior changes with concurrent short prompts vs long completions — let us know typical prompt lengths and token counts so we can pick the right kernel/quantization profile.

If you're leaning onsite, tell us headcount and preferred room and we'll block the calendar.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Daniel King <daniel.king@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, olivia.park@clarityhealth.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify kickoff format & rehearsal — recording and visitor access

Hey all — quick additions from ops side:

- If onsite and you want recording with AV mixer, we need to put in a service ticket 5 business days prior. That means by Sep 13 latest.
- For visitor badges: we need the full legal name + org + driver's license number (or passport). We can accept an encrypted PDF; see the site_access_form fields.
- Network: Lab-3 is on a segmented VLAN with egress rules. If you need outbound access to fhir endpoints during the POC, we'll whitelist the IPs you specify.

Proposed times:
- Preflight routing/load rehearsal: Sep 19 09:00–10:00 PT
- POC kickoff hands-on: Sep 20 10:00–14:00 PT (4-hr block with prompt review + routing tests)

Kimberly — can you tentatively hold Orchard Room for Sep 20? If they prefer Lab-3 we need names by Sep 17.

—Marcus
Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Daniel King <daniel.king@clarityhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: olivia.park@clarityhealth.com, ops@clarityhealth.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify kickoff format & rehearsal — recording and visitor access

Appreciate the details — we want onsite if we can get the Orchard Room and AV recording. We'll plan for 6 engineers on-site and 2 remote observers. We'll return the site_access_form with IDs by Sep 16.

Prompt details: mainly short prompts — 8–20 tokens input, 40–120 tokens output. We'll share a 30-line seed file by Sep 15. For the rehearsal, please synthesize user agents unless you need real emails.

One security question from our InfoSec: will recordings include any PII? We anticipate pseudonymized test data only; confirm whether Redwood logs raw inputs and where those logs live.

Thanks,
Daniel
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Daniel King <daniel.king@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify kickoff format & rehearsal — recording and visitor access

Daniel —

Great, Orchard Room tentatively held for Sep 20 10:00–14:00 PT. Action items and notes below:

- Clarity: return completed site_access_form.pdf + ID scans by Sep 16 (we'll use those to issue visitor badges).
- Recording retention: default 90 days. If you need longer we can add to the SOW.
- Logs & PII: Redwood does not persist raw prompt inputs longer than 7 days for hosted trials by default; we can configure shorter retention or disable input logging for this customer trial. Recordings are audio/video only and do not include raw CLI input logs unless you ask us to enable screen capture. I'll loop Legal if you want a short confirmation note.
- Preflight rehearsal: Sep 19 09:00–10:00 PT — Ben to provision runner VMs; Marcus to warm model instances and set up simulated region failover test.

I'll send calendar invites after I get final headcount. If you want us to run the rehearsal earlier on Sep 18 AM, flag it and we'll try to accommodate.

Best regards,
Kimberly
